blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Filipino pole vault star EJ Obiena will defend his Asian Games title and pursue another record as he leads the Philippines’ 24-member athletics team in Aichi-Nagoya. Obiena enters the competition as the defending men’s pole vault champion after clearing an Asian Games-record 5.90 meters in Hangzhou, China, in 2023. His Asian record of 6.00 meters is a mark that World Athletics still lists as the continental standard. Philippine Athletics and Track and Field Association president Terry Capistrano said Obiena headlines a squad that also includes John Cabang Tolentino, […]...
